item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Iran Defies Trump’s Threats Over Strait of Hormuz Blockade

item.title: Netanyahu Has the War He Always Wanted, but on Trump’s Terms
item.summary: Israel’s prime minister wanted regime change in Iran. But President Trump seems prepared to settle for something less.

item.title: To Fight Iran’s Drones, U.S. Taps Ukraine’s Hard-Earned Knowledge
item.summary: As Iran has shown, warfare involves far more deadly projectiles than it once did. It’s a problem Ukraine has been dealing with for years.

item.title: How the War in Iran Could Help China and Change Asia
item.summary: American officials have said for years that they would prioritize the Indo-Pacific. Now they’re moving warships, missiles and air defenses out for a war in the Middle East.

item.title: A Visit to a Temple at the Heart of the Thailand-Cambodia Conflict

item.title: ‘We Miss Home’: Displaced Lebanese Face Cold Streets and an Uncertain Future
item.summary: Israeli calls for the evacuation of huge swaths of southern Lebanon have led 830,000 people, about 14 percent of Lebanon’s population, to flee.

item.title: Trump and Rubio’s Vision of War: The Art of Destroy and Deal
